title: Every Column Copied
text: The plug is out and the room under the ice stays lit. Whatever keeps the Ledger watched us read it and did nothing, which is either a mercy or a measure of how little it thinks it matters. Every column is copied home.

choices.label: Head home
choices.reply: The lander lifts. Under the ice the room stays lit.

choices.label: Stay a while
choices.reply: We stay. The room under the ice stays lit.
